title: wave defense game I made with pixel art assets.
author: weaponizedLego
selftext:
Me and Claude has made a game, that I wanted to shared with more people. It's fully free right now as it's still in active development. But I need to know if it's actually fun to play

It's a wave defense game that can be played both solo and multiplayer with 4 different diffficulties.

there are different mages(classes) with each their own talent tree for some level of progression.

All digital assets are from craftpixs with most of them a paid subscription.

Game can be found on [mage-defender.com](https://mage-defender.com/)

If you want to try it out I would appreciate if you say yes to metrics. I collect nothing personal. It's game metrics and what browser agent is used.

The game is still actively under development.

It works both on both Mobile and desktop in the browser. Chrome is adviced but I use firefox my self.

In terms of process and aside from the third party assets (digital art) is done claude and my own coding. All sounds are made with the browsers own audio API to synthesize the sound on the go, which is also why it sounds slightly different in each browser xD

I used typescript as the main language, and also as a backend. The game has a small $5/month app runner on digital ocean to serve the page, and run the multiplayer connector with websockets(not really any other choice here)
